'''Harold Ramkissoon''' (14 April 1942 – 15 November 2024) was a Trinidadian mathematician, academic, and science advocate known for his work in fluid dynamics. He served as [[Emeritus|Professor Emeritus]] of Mathematics at the [[University of the West Indies]], and was an independent senator of the [[Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Tack |first1=Clint Chan |title=Senate mourns Prof Harold Ramkissoon |url=https://newsday.co.tt/2024/11/26/senate-mourns-prof-harold-ramkissoon/ |work=Trinidad and Tobago Newsday |date=26 November 2024}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Harold Ramkissoon was born on 14 April 1942,<ref name=":6">{{Cite web |title=Professor Emeritus Harold Ramkissoon |url=http://ttarp.org/magazines/O50Q-2016-1/files/assets/common/downloads/page0018.pdf}}</ref> in [[Tabaquite]], Trinidad, and grew up in Marabella.<ref name=":6" /> He attended Tabaquite RC Primary School and later [[Presentation College, San Fernando|Presentation College]].<ref name=":6" /> In 1966, he earned a Bachelor of Science degree in mathematics from the [[University of the West Indies]] (UWI).<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Professor Harold Ramkissoon {{!}} The Department of Mathematics and Statistics |url=https://sta.uwi.edu/fst/dms/staff/harold-ramkissoon |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=sta.uwi.edu}}</ref><ref name=":6" /> He completed a Master of Science in Mathematics at the [[University of Toronto]] in 1969 and a Ph.D. in applied mathematics at the [[University of Calgary]] in 1975.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":6" /> His doctoral research focused on [[fluid dynamics]], including micropolar fluids, and marangoni instabilities.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Prof Copeland Remarks at Ramkissoon Book Launch My Journey |url=https://sta.uwi.edu/principal/sites/default/files/principal/Prof%20Copeland%20Remarks%20at%20Ramkissoon%20Book%20Launch%20My%20Journey.pdf}}</ref>

In 2019, Ramkissoon received an honorary doctorate from the University of the West Indies and the Faculty of Science and Technology’s Lifetime Achievement Award.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Grenada |first=N. O. W. |date=27 March 2015 |title=Caricom Science Delegation to Visit Cuba {{!}} NOW Grenada |url=https://nowgrenada.com/2015/03/caricom-science-delegation-visit-cuba/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Gioannetti |first=Andrew |date=25 October 2019 |title=UWI honours Prof Ramkissoon |url=https://newsday.co.tt/2019/10/25/uwi-honours-prof-ramkissoon/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Trinidad and Tobago Newsday |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Gittens |first=Tyrell |date=25 November 2019 |title=Prof Ramkissoon gets lifetime award |url=https://newsday.co.tt/2019/11/25/prof-ramkissoon-gets-lifetime-award/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Trinidad and Tobago Newsday |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Career ==
Ramkissoon joined the [[University of the West Indies]] in 1976 as a lecturer in mathematics. He was promoted to senior lecturer in 1982, reader in mathematics in 1990, and, in 1998, became the first West Indian to be appointed to a personal chair in mathematics at UWI.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":4" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Harold Ramkissoon |url=https://ttarp.org/magazines/pdfs/O50Q-2016-1.pdf}}</ref><ref name=":10">{{Cite web |title=Jamaica Gleaner Online |url=http://old.jamaica-gleaner.com/gleaner/20060608/eye/eye3.html |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=old.jamaica-gleaner.com}}</ref> He retired in 2007 and was named [[professor emeritus]].<ref name=":1" />

He collaborated with institutions such as [[University of Cambridge|Cambridge University]], the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]], [[Princeton University]], and the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |title=Harold Ramkissoon Public Lecture |url=https://sta.uwi.edu/media/documents/2015/Harold%20Ramkissoon.pdf}}</ref><ref name=":6" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=IKCEST - Event Report |url=https://www.ikcest.org/article-127340.htm |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=www.ikcest.org}}</ref> Ramkissoon authored over 85 peer-reviewed research papers and contributed to five books in applied mathematics.

Ramkissoon worked to advance science and technology in the Caribbean. He led the Caribbean Academy of Sciences (1994–1998) and the Caribbean Scientific Union (2002–2004).<ref>{{Cite web |title=CASWI.ORG - Brief history of CAS |url=https://www.caswi.org/cas_home/brief-history-of-cas |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=www.caswi.org |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":9">{{Cite web |title=CAS-Prof.Ramkisson.pdf |url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wKzBwhQjsTZQxqjAVRRlHsyP_VljXqJw/view |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Google Docs}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Governing Council |url=https://caribbeanscience.org/governing-council/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Caribbean Science Foundation |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=The Caribbean Academy of Science |url=http://www.caswi.org.jm/casprofile.html |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=www.caswi.org.jm}}</ref> He founded the Caribbean Congress of Fluid Dynamics and chaired regional scientific conferences.<ref name=":2" /> In 2014, Ramkissoon was appointed Chair of the CARICOM Science and Technology (S&T) Committee, launched by Prime Minister [[Keith Mitchell]] of Grenada.<ref name="Sciences TWAS">{{Cite web |last=Sciences (TWAS) |first=The World Academy of |date=21 April 2015 |title=Investing in a Caribbean future |url=https://twas.org/article/investing-caribbean-future |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=twas.org |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=R&D for a Caribbean Future |url=https://twas.org/sites/default/files/media/nl26-4_p23-caribbean.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Roberto |date=6 May 2017 |title=Science, Technology and Innovation in the Caribbean - Strengthening Cooperation Conference was held in Trinidad and Tobago |url=https://council.science/news/science-technology-and-innovation-in-the-caribbean-strengthening-cooperation-conference-was-held-in-trinidad-and-tobago/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=International Science Council |language=en-US}}</ref> From 2010 to 2013, he served as an independent senator in the [[Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago]], advocating for policies supporting research and development.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web |last=Sciences (TWAS) |first=The World Academy of |title=Ramkissoon, Harold {{!}} TWAS |url=https://twas.org/directory/ramkissoon-harold |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=twas.org |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":4" /><ref name=":7">{{Cite web |title=Prof. Harold Ramkissoon – Parliament |url=https://www.ttparliament.org/members/member/prof-harold-ramkissoon/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240416131735/https://www.ttparliament.org/members/member/prof-harold-ramkissoon/ |archive-date=16 April 2024 |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=www.ttparliament.org |language=en-US |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=":8">{{Cite web |title=Calendar .:. Sustainable Development Knowledge Platform |url=https://sustainabledevelopment.un.org/index.php?page=view&nr=942&type=12&menu=1634 |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=sustainabledevelopment.un.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Senator Prof. Harold Ramkissoon |url=https://www.ttparliament.org/members/member/prof-harold-ramkissoon/motions/?pid=RP10}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Four Independents back again |url=https://www.guardian.co.tt/article-6.2.336044.f9779d74cf |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Guardian |language=en}}</ref> He also established the Trinidad and Tobago National Mathematics Olympiad to promote interest in mathematics and science among young people.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Freeport |first=Kevin Baldeosingh |date=30 June 2018 |title=First do the research, Prof Ramkissoon |url=https://trinidadexpress.com/opinion/letters/first-do-the-research-prof-ramkissoon/article_29625aec-7cc6-11e8-934f-77a409a1b15d.html |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Trinidad Express Newspapers |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=International Mathematical Olympiad |url=http://193.2.68.155/country_team_r.aspx?code=TTO&column=awards&order=desc |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=193.2.68.155}}</ref>

In 2017, Harold Ramkissoon launched his autobiography, ''My Journey'', in Trinidad and then in [[Guyana]] through events organized by the University of the West Indies,<ref>{{Cite web |title=St Augustine Campus News {{!}} Welcome to The University of the West Indies at St. Augustine, Trinidad and Tobago |url=https://sta.uwi.edu/news/ecalendar/event.asp?id=2994 |access-date=19 December 2024 |website=sta.uwi.edu}}</ref> the [[University of Guyana]] and the [[Ministry of Education (Guyana)|Ministry of Education]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=My Journey: The Autobiography of Harold Ramkissoon |url=https://www.nalis.gov.tt/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Prof.-Emeritus-Harold-_Ramkissoon.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=KNews |date=18 February 2018 |title=Mathematician, Professor Ramkissoon, launches autobiography in Guyana |url=https://www.kaieteurnewsonline.com/2018/02/18/mathematician-professor-ramkissoon-launches-autobiography-in-guyana/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Kaieteur News |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=18 February 2018 |title=Kaieteur News by GxMedia |url=https://issuu.com/gxmedia/docs/feb182018/46 |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=issuu.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=University of Guyana Library |url=https://library.uog.edu.gy/cgi-bin/koha/opac-search.pl?q=au:Ramkissoon,%20Harold |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=library.uog.edu.gy |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Ramkissoon |first=Harold |url=https://library.uog.edu.gy/cgi-bin/koha/opac-detail.pl?biblionumber=306145&shelfbrowse_itemnumber=521308 |title=My journey: the Autobiography of Harold Ramkissoon |date=2017 |publisher=s.n. |isbn=978-976-8271-51-8 |location=Trinidad and Tobago}}</ref>

Ramkissoon was a founding member and president of the Caribbean Academy of Sciences. He held executive roles in organizations such as the [[InterAcademy Partnership]] and the [[The World Academy of Sciences|Academy of Sciences for the Developing World]] (TWAS).<ref name=":5" /><ref name=":4" /><ref name="Sciences TWAS"/> He participated in the [[Pugwash Conferences on Science and World Affairs]], which received the [[Nobel Peace Prize]] in 1995, and was a fellow of the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Pugwash occasional papers (issued by the Council of the Pugwash Conferences on Science and World Affairs Nobel Peace Prize 1995) |url=https://pugwash.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/200108_occasionalpaper_elimcausesofwar.pdf}}</ref> He was also a corresponding member of science academies in Cuba and Venezuela.<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Tracy |date=30 March 2015 |title=CARICOM Science Delegation Heads to Cuba to Discuss 'Collaboration and Cooperation' |url=https://atlantablackstar.com/2015/03/30/caricom-science-delegation-heads-cuba-discuss-collaboration-cooperation/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Atlanta Black Star |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Death and tributes ==
Ramkissoon died on 15 November 2024, at the age of 82.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Harold Ramkissoon {{!}} Cuban Academy of Sciences |url=https://www.academiaciencias.cu/index.php/en/membership/harold-ramkissoon |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=www.academiaciencias.cu}}</ref> The Office of the [[President of Trinidad and Tobago]] and the [[Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago]] acknowledged his contributions and achievements on 26 November.<ref name=":7" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Unrevised Senate Debate - CONDOLENCES (PROFESSOR EMERITUS HAROLD RAMKISSOON) |url=https://www.ttparliament.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/hs20241126u.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Tack |first=Clint Chan |date=26 November 2024 |title=Senate mourns Prof Harold Ramkissoon |url=https://newsday.co.tt/2024/11/26/senate-mourns-prof-harold-ramkissoon/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Trinidad and Tobago Newsday |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=CONDOLENCES ON THE PASSING OF PROFESSOR EMERITUS HAROLD RAMKISSOON |url=https://otp.tt/condolences-on-the-passing-of-professor-emeritus-harold-ramkissoon/}}</ref><ref name=":9" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=27 November 2024 |title=Ex-UNC Obika appointed temporary PNM senator |url=https://trinidadexpress.com/newsextra/ex-unc-obika-appointed-temporary-pnm-senator/article_ee6cf59a-aca3-11ef-aa0e-779b40184454.html |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Trinidad Express Newspapers |language=en}}</ref>

== Awards and recognition ==
Ramkissoon received several awards for his contributions to education, including the [[Chaconia Medal|Chaconia Gold Medal]] in 2000,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gazette No.167 Vol.39 31st August 2000 Extraordinary |url=https://www.news.gov.tt/archive/E-Gazette/Gazette%202000/G%20167.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Chaconia Gold Medal - 40 years of National Awards |url=https://www.news.gov.tt/sites/default/files/40yrs_of_National_Awards.pdf}}</ref> the [[International Simón Bolívar Prize|Simón Bolívar Academic]] Gold Medal in 2001, and the Caricom Science Award in 2006.<ref name=":10" /><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":5" /> He was awarded honorary Doctor of Science degrees from the [[University of Technology, Jamaica]], in 2011, and the [[University of the West Indies at St. Augustine|University of the West Indies, St. Augustine]], in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof Harold Ramkissoon |url=https://utechalumni.wordpress.com/tag/prof-harold-ramkissoon/ |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=UTech Alumni Blog |language=en}}</ref>

Ramkissoon was a recipient of fellowships from the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] and the [[Fulbright Program|Fulbright Foundation]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Dr. h.c. Harold Ramkissoon |url=https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/en/connect/explore-the-humboldt-network/singleview/1022772/prof-dr-dr-h-c-harold-ramkissoon |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=www.humboldt-foundation.de |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":2" /> and he was inducted into the CARISCIENCE Hall of Fame in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 December 2015 |title=Region's top scientists inducted in Hall of Fame |url=https://trinidadexpress.com/features/region-s-top-scientists-inducted-in-hall-of-fame/article_62855e41-9102-5c61-94ba-5025fd462843.html |access-date=11 December 2024 |website=Trinidad Express Newspapers |language=en}}</ref>

== Books ==
Ramkissoon’s published works include:
* ''Differential Equations'' (2011)
* ''The Element of Calculus'' (2010, with C. De Matas)
* ''Lubricated Transport of Viscous Materials'' (1998, editor), [[Springer Science+Business Media|Kluwer Academic Publishers]].
* ''Complex Analysis'' (1998, with B. Tom)
* ''Differential Complex Analysis'' (1996, with B. Tom)

== Selected papers ==
* "Drag on an Axially Symmetric Body in the Stokes' Flow of Micropolar Fluids" Authors: H. Ramkissoon and S.R. Majumdar, ''[[Physics of Fluids]]'', vol. 19, pp.&nbsp;16–21, 1976.
* "Representations in Hydrodynamics" Author: H. Ramkissoon, ''[[Acta Mechanica]]'', vol. 28, pp.&nbsp;49–53, 1977.
* "Potentials and Green's Functions in Micropolar Fluid Theory" Authors: H. Ramkissoon and S.R. Majumdar, ''[[Journal of Applied Mathematics and Mechanics|Zeitschrift für Angewandte Mathematik und Mechanik]] (Z.A.M.M.)'', vol. 60, pp.&nbsp;249–255, 1980.
* "Integral Representations in Hydrodynamics" Author: H. Ramkissoon, ''[[Acta Mechanica]]'', vol. 50, pp.&nbsp;119–125, 1983.
* "On a Planar Exterior Problem in Linear Elasticity" Author: H. Ramkissoon, ''Quarterly of Applied Mathematics'', vol. 43, pp.&nbsp;135–141, 1985.
* "Stokes Flow Past a Slightly Deformed Fluid Sphere" Author: H. Ramkissoon, ''Zeitschrift für Angewandte Mathematik und Physik (Z.A.M.P.)'', vol. 37, pp.&nbsp;859–866, 1986.
* "Stokes Flow Past a Reiner-Rivlin Liquid Sphere" Author: H. Ramkissoon, ''Zeitschrift für Angewandte Mathematik und Mechanik (Z.A.M.M.)'', vol. 69, pp.&nbsp;259–261, 1989.
* "Non-Newtonian Flow Between Concentric Cylinders" Authors: H. Ramkissoon and C.V. Easwaran, ''Zeitschrift für Angewandte Mathematik und Mechanik (Z.A.M.M.)'', vol. 72, 1993
* "Visco-Elastic Flow in Tubes Subjected to Pulses" Authors: H. Ramkissoon and S.R. Majumdar, ''International Journal of Engineering Science'', vol. 33, pp.&nbsp;217–221, 1995.
* "Stokes Flow Past a Non-Newtonian Spheroid" Author: H. Ramkissoon, ''[[Journal of Applied Mathematics and Mechanics|Zeitschrift für Angewandte Mathematik und Mechanik]]'', vol. 78, pp.&nbsp;61–66, 1997.
* "Marangoni Instabilities in a Two-Layer Fluid System" Authors: H. Ramkissoon and D. Comissiong, ''[[Journal of Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics]]'', vol. 26, pp.&nbsp;243–253, 2001.
* "On Thermal Instabilities in a Viscoelastic Fluid Subject to Internal Heat Generation" Authors: H. Ramkissoon, D. Comissiong, T. Dass, and A. Sankar, ''[[World Academy of Science, Engineering and Technology]]'', vol. 80, pp.&nbsp;826–833, 2011.
